name: Shooting Star
description: A single bearish reversal candle that forms after an uptrend. It has a small real body near the bottom of the candle's range and a long upper wick at least 2 times the body length, indicating that buyers pushed price up significantly but sellers drove it back down to near the open by close.

body_rules.body_position: must be in the lower third of the total candle range
body_rules.body_color: preferably bearish (red/black) but bullish body is still valid with confirmation

wick_rules.upper_wick: must be at least 2 times the length of the real body
wick_rules.lower_wick: little to none; lower wick should be no more than 10-15% of the total range
wick_rules.wick_direction: the long wick must point upward

context_requirement: must form at or near a defined resistance level after an uptrend of at least 3-5 candles; shooting star in a downtrend or ranging market is not a valid signal
volume_requirement: above-average volume on the shooting star candle strengthens the signal; high volume rejection at resistance is a strong bearish sign
agent_rules: Only trade shooting star at a confirmed resistance zone, trendline, or Fibonacci level
Require a bearish confirmation candle closing below the shooting star's low before entering short
Stop loss should be placed above the shooting star's high
A shooting star with very high volume is a stronger signal than one on low volume
Do not trade a shooting star that gaps far away from price context
A bullish-bodied shooting star (inverted color) requires stronger confirmation from the next candle
The longer the prior uptrend, the more significant the shooting star reversal signal
